mapper.select: SELECT S."ID", s.SUBJECT_ORDER AS subjectOrder, s.SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, s.CREATE_TIME AS createTime FROM APP_SUBJECT s, APP_CATALOG c WHERE s.SUBJECT_ORDER >= 0 AND s.CATALOG_CODE = c.CATALOG_CODE AND s.DEL_FLAG = '1' AND s.PUBLISH_FLAG = '1' AND c.CATALOG_NAME = '裕同简介' ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_ORDER

SELECT S."ID",CT.PIC_BINARY,S.SUBJECT_NAME, S.CREATE_TIME, S.UPDATE_TIME FROM APP_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN APP_CATALOG C ON S.CATALOG_CODE = C.CATALOG_CODE, APP_CONTENT_TEXT CT,APP_SUBJECT_CONTENT_TEXT SCT WHERE s."ID" = SCT.SUBJECT_ID and CT."ID" = SCT.CONTENT_TEXT_ID and S.PUBLISH_FLAG = '2' AND S.DEL_FLAG = '1' AND C.CATALOG_NAME = '裕同简介' ORDER BY S.UPDATE_TIME DESC

SELECT S."ID", CT.PIC_BINARY, S.SUBJECT_NAME, S.UPDATE_TIME FROM APP_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN APP_CATALOG C ON S.CATALOG_CODE = C.CATALOG_CODE, APP_CONTENT_TEXT CT,APP_SUBJECT_CONTENT_TEXT SCT WHERE s."ID" = scT.SUBJECT_ID and CT."ID" = SCT.CONTENT_TEXT_ID and S.PUBLISH_FLAG = '0' AND S.DEL_FLAG = '1' AND C.CATALOG_NAME = '裕同简介' ORDER BY S.UPDATE_TIME DESC

SELECT S.SUBJECT_NAME, CT.PIC_BINARY, CT.TEXT_DESC FROM APP_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN APP_CATALOG C ON S.CATALOG_CODE = C.CATALOG_CODE, APP_CONTENT_TEXT CT, APP_SUBJECT_CONTENT_TEXT SCT WHERE S."ID" = #{id} AND S."ID" = SCT.SUBJECT_ID AND CT."ID" = SCT.CONTENT_TEXT_ID AND S.DEL_FLAG = '1'

SELECT S."ID", S.SUBJECT_ORDER FROM APP_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN APP_CATALOG C ON S.CATALOG_CODE = C.CATALOG_CODE WHERE S.SUBJECT_ORDER >= #{order} AND S.DEL_FLAG = '1' AND S.PUBLISH_FLAG = '1' AND C.CATALOG_NAME = '裕同简介'

SELECT COUNT(S.PUBLISH_FLAG) FROM APP_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN APP_CATALOG C ON S.CATALOG_CODE = C.CATALOG_CODE WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '1' AND S.PUBLISH_FLAG = '1' AND S.SUBJECT_ORDER > 0 AND C.CATALOG_NAME = '裕同简介'
SELECT S.* FROM APP_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN APP_CATALOG C ON S.CATALOG_CODE = C.CATALOG_CODE WHERE S.SUBJECT_ORDER = #{order} AND S.DEL_FLAG = '1' AND S.PUBLISH_FLAG = '1' AND C.CATALOG_NAME = '裕同简介'
SELECT S.* FROM APP_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN APP_CATALOG C ON S.CATALOG_CODE = C.CATALOG_CODE WHERE S."ID" = #{id} AND S.DEL_FLAG = '1' AND S.PUBLISH_FLAG = '2' AND C.CATALOG_NAME = '裕同简介'
